target.definition: Total transaction value of online shopping in South Korea during August 2026, as first reported in the National Data Office's monthly Online Shopping Trends release.

inputs.name: annual_online_retail_2025
inputs.description: Total online shopping transaction value in South Korea for calendar year 2025

provenance.rationale: Monthly online shopping trends ran around 20 trillion KRW/month in 2024-2025, giving roughly 240 trillion KRW/year

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor of online shopping value from 2025 to 2026

provenance.rationale: Online shopping growth has slowed to mid-single digits as the market matures

inputs.name: august_seasonal_index
inputs.description: Ratio of August transaction value to the average month (August includes summer holiday effects)

provenance.rationale: August is a typical-to-slightly-soft month with no major shopping festival

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year

provenance.rationale: Calendar constant

inputs.name: population
inputs.description: Population of South Korea

provenance.rationale: Resident population around 51-52 million in mid-2020s

inputs.name: online_shopping_participation_share
inputs.description: Share of population making online purchases in a given month

provenance.rationale: Roughly half of Koreans report online purchases in a month

inputs.name: purchases_per_buyer_per_month
inputs.description: Average number of online purchase transactions per active buyer per month

provenance.rationale: Frequent small purchases plus occasional larger orders

inputs.name: average_transaction_value
inputs.description: Average value per online shopping transaction

provenance.rationale: Mix of small food/daily items and larger electronics/clothing orders

inputs.name: household_consumption_expenditure
inputs.description: Annual household final consumption expenditure in South Korea

provenance.rationale: Korean household consumption is roughly 900-1000 trillion KRW per year

inputs.name: online_share_of_consumption
inputs.description: Share of household consumption expenditure spent through online shopping transactions

provenance.rationale: Online shopping is about a quarter of household consumption in Korea

inputs.name: august_share_of_year
inputs.description: Share of annual online shopping value falling in August

provenance.rationale: One-twelfth of the year adjusted slightly for August seasonality

paths.description: Scale 2025 annual online shopping value by growth and August seasonal index, divided by 12 months
Count active online buyers times purchases per buyer times average transaction value
Take online share of annual household consumption and allocate the August share

problems: path p1: dimension mismatch: the formula gives count per time (s**-1), but the target needs a pure number, a count or a share (dimensionless). The formula has one 'per time' more than the target; inputs with a time unit in this path: months_per_year ('months'). If the target is a total over a period, multiply by an input whose unit is a length of time: the period itself (for example days_in_period with unit 'day'), or period_length = 1 with unit 'year' when a share of the year then picks the part you need. A share, or a ratio such as 'days/year', has no time unit and does not cancel it.
